svg.title: Tickets persist while agent execution interleaves
svg.desc: Agent A pauses requirements research while awaiting a source, drafts the news report, then resumes requirements. Agent B inventories systems concurrently. Implementation remains blocked until requirements and inventory satisfy acceptance. Recovery changes the current attempt and fences the old one; it does not erase tickets.
svg.text: Independent work, concurrent with Agent A
A yields one ticket and works another. B works in parallel. The join waits for accepted prerequisites.
